decisions.text: Candy is a built-in style, like Play, HUD and Arcade: style id and layout both 'candy', fifth in the picker, its look page /settings/look/candy, the bundled Auto 'never' (it draws its own, D-CAN-5), and installing automatos/candy switches the phone to it (BUILT_IN_THEME_STYLES 'automatos/candy': 'candy').

The theme id is automatos/candy, first-party; its mobile block (fromLooks, Outfit SemiBold and Nunito Regular as its two faces, Auto as stills) stays as the skin a build without the Candy layout paints on Studio.

Looks are the web's (candy-look/v1, interface 'candy'; six knobs: palette, cards, gradient and motion choices, roundness a choice of the keys '16' to '40' (strings, kit 1.0.1) and glow a whole number 0–10; three presets Blush, Lilac, Night bloom), stored on the phone under styles.candy.looks with sync marks under styles.candy.looks.sync, synced through GET/PUT /api/themes/looks/automatos/candy (the theme id as path segments, as looksRoute sends Play's, HUD's and Arcade's; never '%2F'). Not installed (404): the looks stay on the phone and the page says 'Candy isn't installed in this workspace, so your looks stay on this phone.'
Outfit (600, 700) and Nunito (400, 700, 800) are bundled as static TTF with their OFL licences; the app.json expo-font change makes the merge a native build (accepted, one build).

Auto in Candy is the kit's glossy Auto, drawn with Skia from the vendored geometry (src/art/auto-geometry.ts and auto-path.ts at the pin; twelve states through EYE_FORMS), never the bundled clips; he floats 4 pt over 3 s and blinks every 4–6 s on one clock; he is still under Reduce Motion, the look's Motion 'paused', or the phone's own pause (styles.candy.motionPaused, never synced), and a pause control sits wherever Candy loops (WCAG 2.2.2). VoiceOver hears 'Auto, {what he is doing}'.

The home is P1 Today / P2 Chat / P3 Shelf / P4 Team, switched in place by the floating pill tab bar (Today, Chat, [A6 voice, raised], Shelf, Team) on Today, Shelf and Team; Chat is the view a conversation route opens. Everything shows only data the app already reads (needs-you, the Board, the chat's agents, the Deliverables gallery, A2's one thread); no new endpoint. The orb shows the needs-you number with the caption 'need you' (the Board's rows carry no completion time: openQuestions Q1).
Light and Dark: the palette sets the tone (Blush and Lilac light, Night bloom dark), as Play's ground and Arcade's palette do; Studio's Light / Dark / System does not apply while Candy is on.
PRD-268's brief, suggestions and approval sheet, on main since Go #31–#33, are wired into Candy as HudHome and PlayHome wire them (US-023n); no PRD-268 behaviour changes.

Paint is the kit's: card gradients, the band, the orb and the aura drawn with Skia by CANDY-LAYOUT §3's rules over the kit's catalogue (its AA start stops #D73178 and #2675D3 supersede the handoff's #D93A7E and #2878D8); the phone's cards, tiles and windows take rs = round(r × 0.72), pills 999, icons and avatars are circles; the glow is 0.04 + glow / 33 (the kit's prepaint).
decisions.source: CANDY-LAYOUT §3; the kit's catalogue.ts and boot/prepaint.json

decisions.text: No WebView anywhere, in any style; nothing from a theme or the server is rendered as web content.
The app never loads JavaScript, CSS or HTML from a theme or the server. Candy's drawing is vendored into the app's own source at a pinned kit commit, never downloaded.
The Command Centre, sheets and settings are ONE set of screens dressed by each style's tokens and the shared primitives; no screen is copied per style.
One voice screen, one dress per style: Candy's core is the orb at 240 with Auto in it, its rings and waveform in the card gradients; colours come from the resolved style.

Layouts read tokens only. Colour literals live only in src/styles/tokens/ (the lint rule and the gate); the vendored Candy catalogue, the gradient model's colours and Auto's colours live there too, and the one helper that turns an Auto colour and an alpha into a colour string.

The AiLabel is one small muted caption that opens every thread in every style (the Chat view's first row) and sits on the voice screen; never a pill, never a lock, never drawn over. src/styles/ai-label.tsx is never edited (gate-enforced).

Nothing below 11 pt anywhere (MIN_TEXT_SIZE, the release a11y audit); Candy's own steps never below 12 (the handoff's minimum), so the design's 10 px tab labels and 11 px meta lines are 12; Dynamic Type with layouts that wrap (the tab bar included); every status a glyph and a word (● Working, ○ Ready, ✓ on tool lines), never colour alone; small white text only over a gradient's a and b stops, the c stop carries large figures only (3:1); every animated signal has a text twin; Reduce Motion, the look's Motion 'paused' and the pause control stop every loop; tap targets 44 pt.

Files 200-400 lines (never over 800), functions under 50, components under 150, nesting under 4; pure logic in plain TS with vitest tests beside it (pure modules import no react, react-native, expo-* or @shopify/react-native-skia); immutability; Candy's copy in src/styles/candy/strings.ts — src/styles/strings.ts (766 lines at the base; 800 fails the lint) takes only the entries its shared maps demand.

This wave may create or change ONLY: src/styles/** (never src/styles/ai-label.tsx), src/ui/Slider.tsx and src/ui/dressed.ts (additive), src/voice/home/use-candy-home-voice.ts, src/voice/home/candy-home-voice.ts, src/voice/screen/**, src/voice/nav.ts, app/(app)/settings/look/candy.tsx, assets/fonts/outfit/**, assets/fonts/nunito/**, assets/fonts/SOURCES.md, app.json's expo-font list and src/config/__tests__/app-config.test.ts's font count (US-023d only), docs/styles-and-themes.md, docs/prd/PRD-001-AUTOMATOS-GO-V1.md (the addendum, US-023's boxes), CLAUDE.md (the styles count), the PRD-268 folders src/brief/**, src/suggestions/** and src/approvals/** (US-023n, additive), additive exports in src/chat/** and src/cc/** (SEAM EDIT), the release audits' entry lists src/release/__tests__/support/surfaces.ts and src/release/__tests__/support/a11y-allowed.ts (an entry with the file, the exact text and the reason; never an assertion), the tests beside each, and this kit's files under scripts/ralph/ (*candy*). Never: src/core/**, core.lock.json, src/api/**, src/navigation/routes.ts, package.json, package-lock.json, eas.json, .eas/**, .github/**, any other assets/fonts/** family.

openQuestions.question: CANDY-LAYOUT Open question 1: is 'completed today' available from the app's Command Centre read?
openQuestions.answer: No. The Board read (GET /api/v1/tasks; src/cc/board/schemas.ts BOARD_TICKET_FIELDS) carries created_at and updated_at only; completed_at is on the single-ticket read alone (TicketDetailSchema, GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}), and no other read the app makes (src/api/needs-you.ts, the calendar's /api/activity/schedule, the Deliverables gallery) carries a completion count. Arcade reached the same answer for XP (src/styles/homes/arcade-home.ts arcadeCounters: xp null). So P1's orb shows useNeedsYou().total with the caption 'need you', and no endpoint is added (D-CAN-6).

openQuestions.question: CANDY-LAYOUT Open question 3: are Auto's final 12 states approved first, or does Candy ship on the concept?
openQuestions.answer: It ships on the twelve states the kit's own art draws: src/art/auto-geometry.ts at the pin (EYE_FORMS: idle, listening, thinking, celebrate, hello, sleeping, loading, working, reading, searching, oops, lost — the concept's shapes and the rest in its spirit), the same file the web draws as SVG and the kit rasterises its phone stills from. Final art from design-a-mascot, if it comes, lands in the kit first and reaches the phone by re-vendoring at a new pin; nothing in the layout changes.

repoContradictions: CANDY-LAYOUT §5 names /api/themes/looks/automatos%2Fcandy; the repo sends the theme id as path segments (src/styles/routes.ts '{theme_id:path}', src/styles/play/looks-api.ts looksRoute: never '%2F'), so Candy's route is /api/themes/looks/automatos/candy.

P1 greets 'Hi, {first name}'; the app reads no person's name (the session holds the workspace and the role: src/app-state/account.ts, src/api/workspace.ts) and the kit's own Today has none (today-words.ts greetingFor): Candy says 'Good morning' / 'Good afternoon' / 'Good evening'.

P4's '● Active / ○ Inactive' and job titles: GET /api/chat/agents (src/chat/schemas.ts ChatAgentSchema) carries id, name, agent_type, description and is_default, no status and no job title. Each agent's state comes from what the app reads, as Arcade's party does (src/styles/arcade/home/party.ts): Needs you, Working or Ready; 'active' is working or needing you; the line under a name is its description, else its type.
The kit's KIND_SETS keys 'slides' and 'blog'; the app's Deliverable types are 'slide' and 'blog_post' (src/cc/deliverables/types.ts KNOWN_TYPES): Candy maps the app's names onto the kit's sets.
P3's 44 px search circle has no read behind it (the gallery's query is limit, offset, artifact_type and source_type_exclude: src/cc/deliverables/gallery.ts galleryParams): left out.

The design's Today, Shelf and Team headers have no menu, but D73's one menu (New chat, Chats, Command Centre, Settings) must be reachable from every home: a 44 pt menu circle with the needs-you number at each view's top right (on Chat, the stage's menu circle).
CANDY-LAYOUT §4's 10 px tab labels and 11 px Shelf meta lines are under the handoff README's own 12 px minimum; the repo's a11y audit holds 11 pt (src/styles/type.ts MIN_TEXT_SIZE): both are 12.

Handoff, not repo: CANDY-LAYOUT §3 gives cards and windows rs, the handoff README and the kit's frame/look-vars.ts give them r (rs for inner tiles); the phone follows CANDY-LAYOUT and the 390 mocks (rs), with r for the edge screens' window and Make it sweet's preview (§5, §7).
Handoff, not repo: the README's glow 0.04 + glow × 0.03 is the kit's 0.04 + glow / 33 rounded; the phone uses the kit's.

acceptanceCriteria: app/(app)/settings/look/candy.tsx renders StyleSync then src/styles/candy/look-page/CandyLookPage.tsx (the US-023a stand-in is gone: CandyLookStandIn.tsx and CANDY_LOOK_SOON_COPY deleted), inside a StyleScope in the look being edited: 'Make it sweet' and its line; the presets as three cards with mini previews (a GradientCard each in that preset's palette), radiogroup / radio; Palette as three 38 pt circles (radio, the palette's name to VoiceOver); Card colours (Mixed / One colour) and Gradient (Soft / Rich / Vivid with CANDY_GRADIENT_NOTES under it) as segmented rows; Roundness (16–40 on src/ui/Slider in whole steps, written as its choice key String(n) through setKnob) and Glow (0–10 on src/ui/Slider through setNumber); Motion as React Native's Switch (accessibilityRole switch), which under Reduce Motion says 'Motion off · Reduce Motion' and cannot be changed

A live preview (CandyAuto with three mini GradientCards in the look being edited), Save look (saveAsNew, 'My look N'), Reset (the palette's preset), the saved looks after the presets with a long press for Rename or Delete through Play's LookSheet (src/styles/play/look-page/LookSheet.tsx); changes apply at once through setCandyLooks and sync as US-023c set up; the not-installed words when the server says Candy isn't installed; CandyPauseButton on the page (the preview's Auto floats), listed in the pause-reach test
Pure page rules in src/styles/candy/look-page/*.ts with tests (the rows, the choice words, the slider steps, Reduce Motion's row); components under 150 lines

src/styles/picker/previews/CandyPreview.tsx (the stand-in in PREVIEWS is gone): a small Today in the default look — a band, the orb with a figure, three mini cards and Auto — every moving part passed still (the card moves nothing); picker/cards.ts selectedPaint (the accent, AA on win in every preset, tested) and its words gain Candy's; the card reads 'Candy', 'Bright, glossy and round' and 'Make it sweet →'
npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npx vitest run pass
userStories.notes: SEAM EDIT note for app/(app)/settings/look/candy.tsx. Arcade's US-022j and Play's look page (src/styles/play/look-page/) are the models; Play's LookSheet is shared. The look's Motion knob is the synced one; the page's CandyPauseButton is the phone's own pause.

userStories.title: PRD-268's slots in Candy, the docs, and no stand-in left
userStories.description: As Automatos, we want Candy to have what every layout has, and the docs to say there are five layouts (D-CAN-8).
acceptanceCriteria: The runner has merged origin/main in before this story when it moved. PRD-268's code is on the base (src/brief/, src/suggestions/, src/approvals/: Go #31–#33), so the Candy home wires each as HudHome and PlayHome do: useIdeas (src/suggestions/use-ideas.tsx; 'Ideas · N' on Today's header opening its sheet, PinnedSuggestion above the Chat view's composer as PlayHome places it); the day's brief (src/brief/: in the Chat view's thread rows through threadRows with canBrief as PlayHome does, or useHudBrief's slot on Today — the DONE note says which); the approval sheet's under-chip line (src/approvals/use-hud-approval.tsx useHudApproval) under the stage's state pill; no PRD-268 behaviour changed; any of the three not on the base is listed as 'PRD-268 SEAM OPEN: <which>'

docs/styles-and-themes.md describes five layouts (Studio, Play, HUD, Arcade, Candy), what each draws (Candy: Today, Chat, Shelf and Team behind the floating tab bar, Auto drawn with Skia, the orb), that automatos/play, automatos/hud, automatos/arcade and automatos/candy switch the phone to theirs while every other theme paints Studio through its skin, that a build from before Candy paints automatos/candy's skin on Studio, Candy's looks (styles.candy.looks, the route, the not-installed words), where Candy's pause sits and that styles.candy.motionPaused is never synced; CLAUDE.md's 'four styles' and 'four layouts' lines say five and its Design sources name Candy's handoff and the kit's themes/candy at 3920359d5
docs/prd/PRD-001-AUTOMATOS-GO-V1.md US-023's boxes are ticked with the evidence that is in the code (screenshots stay Gerard's: ownerTest OT-C1..C6)

The pause-reach test lists every moving Candy part with its host and passes; `grep -rn CANDY_STAND_IN src app` finds nothing; no file over 800 lines; npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npx vitest run, npm run check:bundle, npm run check:routes and npx expo-doctor pass
